message.content: {"baseline":{"title":"MiniSearch update: How practical is its remote server API setup for local LLM inference engines?","body":"MiniSearch has been updated to collect more textual and graphical results during web research sessions, aiming to provide more grounded answers for follow-up questions. It supports running locally via Docker or using a public Hugging Face Space instance. The default setup uses small LLMs running in the browser, but users can opt to connect to local inference engines like LM Studio, Ollama, or vLLM—or cloud servers—by selecting \"Remote server (API)\" and configuring API Base URL, Access Key, and Model. The chat context is managed with a sliding window under 4k tokens, and the app is optimized for mobile browsers, though memory limits depend on the device. Given these features, has anyone here integrated MiniSearch with local inference engines through the remote API option? What has your experience been regarding setup complexity, latency, and reliability?
